data.long_meaning: Bibhash means wise, intelligent, and knowledgeable in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bibhatsa' which means frightening or terrifying, but the name Bibhash carries a positive connotation of being intelligent and wise. The name Bibhash carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bibhash usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Bibhash Chakravarti Thakur was a renowned Bengali poet, scholar and dramatist of the late 18th and early 19th centuries. He is best known for his works in the genre of Bhrama-charitra (the stories of gods).

Bibhash was also a prominent figure in the Hindu reform movement of the 19th century, advocating for the revival of traditional Hindu practices and the eradication of social evils. He is known for his critical work 'Saraswati-Tilak', which challenged the prevailing orthodoxy and influenced the emergence of modern Hinduism and its intellectual discourse.
